description: This file defines the LeadFormBase class, which extends PersonFormBase, and handles the presentation and processing of lead-related forms in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering forms, handling lead duplication checks, and saving lead data, including association with accounts and inbound emails.

classes.name: LeadFormBase
classes.description: A class for managing Lead form rendering and processing, including duplicate detection, account linkage, and inbound email handling in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to check for potential duplicate leads based on first and last name, filtering out converted or deleted records.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Returns HTML code for a detailed wide form for lead data entry, including address, phone, and email fields.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Returns HTML code for a standard lead form with essential fields like name, phone, and email.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form for creating or editing a lead, including form headers, footers, and JavaScript validation.

methods.name: handleLeadAccountName
methods.description: Associates a lead with an account based on the account name, updating the account_id accordingly.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Performs validation, duplicate checking, saving, and related entity updates for a lead based on form input.
